title: viz1090
summary: Full-screen ADS-B display: live aircraft from an RTL-SDR dongle on a world map.
description: The real viz1090 (by Nathan Matsuda) on the deck, full screen, with its own decoder (readsb with RTL-SDR support), an intro screen (type the nearest airport code, or use a GPS) and a world map. Needs an RTL-SDR dongle with a 1090 MHz antenna and a launcher with full-screen support (X-Fullscreen in .desktop files). Map data: Natural Earth and OurAirports. viz1090: BSD licence; readsb: GPL-3 (source: https://github.com/wiedehopf/readsb).
depends: libsdl2-2.0-0, libsdl2-ttf-2.0-0, libsdl2-gfx-1.0-0, librtlsdr0, libusb-1.0-0, libfreetype6, libncurses6, libzstd1, zlib1g, python3
